input: One submitted six-second 16 kHz PCM16 mono mixture. No clean copy, source stems, annotation, enhancement, VAD, or learned weights enter inference. Use the 12 separate calibration readers and four room excerpts and the 16 held readers and four separate room excerpts reserved by audio-standalone-dual-view-sources-2026-11-18.json. Known scores from that earlier study are used only to compare the incumbent on the exact primary inputs. A case split is a reader and a background-room split within this trial. These recordings have prior project exposure.
primary: At -5 and +3 dB foreground-to-room ratio, retain the exact pinned unchanged, same-recording ordinary splice, publisher-annotated speech edit, and isolated-room inputs. Validate every inherited PCM commitment. Add matched 3 dB level dip and local 2.4 kHz low-pass controls with equal-amplitude edge fades. They are ordinary processing, not source replacement. Exclude the actual speech edit from calibration.
diagnostic: Start from the clean original foreground. Within its paired published interval, temporarily replace only the original room by the next split-local room excerpt, scaled to equal whole-excerpt RMS. Cross-fade 40 ms at each boundary, with the same inherited noise level. Use the original paired mix gain. Use separately annotated replacement intervals and report their localization apart from synthetic speech edits. These are deliberately authored acoustic changes, not AI-origin positives.
measure: Use 40 ms Hann windows with 10 ms sample spacing. Compute sum power of 16 bands with edges 140,220,320,450,620,820,1050,1350,1700,2100,2600,3150,3800,4550,5400,6400,7600 Hz. For the candidate use the 20th percentile of log power in each band over 300 ms. For the ablation use the median. Center the shape by removing its across-band median. For a candidate interval compare the 300 ms bands just outside both ends and just inside both ends, separated by 40 ms. Require each support to have 20th-percentile whole-frame RMS above -60 dBFS. Shape distance is RMS of per-band differences clipped at 20 dB, rounded to integer millionths of a decibel. The score is the weaker across-boundary distance minus the larger of the outer-to-outer and inner-to-inner distances. Rank intervals of 400,520,680,840,1040,1280 and 1560 ms starting at 360 ms and stepping every 40 ms. Return one strongest interval with earliest start then earliest end as ties.
calibration: For each quantile, freeze the greatest integer score across calibration readers' ordinary clips and calibration room clips. Calibration only sees ordinary scoring. Assess the median arm separately, irrespective of the lower-quantile result. Held alerts strictly exceed the frozen point.
gates: Standalone speech localization requires the lower foreground-to-room ratio to gain at least three useful fallback locations from distinct held readers without any matched control at that clock, to add at most two ordinary alerts on original and same-recording splice files at each level, and to add no isolated-room flag. The incumbent keeps its flagged range before fallback. A useful interval covers at least half the annotated duration and at least 0.30 temporal intersection over union. For the separate descriptive background diagnostic, require at least eight useful replacement intervals at -5 dB across at least three donor rooms, no more than two total alerts on the four ordinary control types at each level, and zero isolated-room alerts. Neither outcome measures standalone AI authorship.
reproducibility: Record exact input PCM hashes, source roles, proposals, score, and component distances. Recount the freeze and results using only Python's standard library. Retain no audio, embeddings, or per-frame spectra. Use SINE Apache 2.0 and AMI CC BY 4.0 publisher sources.
